text:
Alex: Heads-up — RC cutover scheduled 22:00 UTC. PR #9842 (model-routing fallback) needs a double signoff before cutoff. Pinged owners but short on time. Who can be second reviewer?
Maria: I can take a look, @Alex. Are the smoke tests green?
deploy-bot: CI status for PR #9842: 7/8 checks passed, integration-smoke flaky — rerun queued. https://ci.internal/pr/9842
Alex: thx bot. Smoke flake repro locally. I pushed a tiny mitigation in the PR, it's the last commit 'fix(kv): tolerate empty-prefetch'. Needs a sanity pass (no new perf regressions).
Ben: I can do the perf + infra-owned bits. ETA ~30m. If Maria can do correctness, we can get the two signoffs before 22:00.
Maria: quick skim done — change looks small, tests reasonable. One minor nit inline. I can approve after Ben gives perf ok. :+1:
Sophia: If timing gets tight, can we allow a shadow approve from infra-oncall (me) + one core-eng owner? Policy says two maintainers but we have approved exceptions for rollbacks. Thoughts?
Alex: Let's avoid special exceptions if possible. Ben + Maria preferred. But Soph, if Ben gets delayed and you're oncall, go ahead and standby as backup.
Ben: ran perf locally, no alloc spike. Approving now.
Ben: APPROVED
Maria: APPROVED
deploy-bot: Merge checklist: approvals=2, CI=waiting-rerun. Merge-block = false once CI green. Queueing post-approval merge.
Alex: Thanks everyone — I'll watch the cutover. If CI rerun fails, fallback plan is immediate rollback and notify #incidents.
Sophia: Copy. I'll be on standby for rollbacks. Good luck!
